links.outcome: Segmentation Dice improvement after local retraining of internationally pretrained 3D-UNet
links.effect: HITL retraining with local CT scans improved DSC by ~0.2 (normal lung) and ~0.5 (COVID-19 pneumonia); DSC >0.96/0.81 after three cycles.
links.quote: The HITL strategy improved the DSC by 0.2 and 0.5 for the normal lung parenchyma and COVID-19 pneumonia segmentation, respectively.

links.outcome: Local validation against predefined Dice criteria
links.effect: DSCs exceeded radiologist criteria of DSC ≥0.95/0.8 for lung parenchyma/COVID-19 pneumonia on non-contrast and contrast-enhanced CT scans.
links.quote: The performance of the HITL approach in terms of the DSC for non-contrast and contrast-enhanced CT scans yielded values that were superior to the coefficients defined by radiologists (DSC ≥ 0.95/0.8 for normal lung parenchyma/COVID-19 pneumonia).
